1.o: Shy Akane is the fourth of nine siblings of the Royal Sakurada Family. Although she cannot even pass by a surveillance camera without wanting to hide, her father, the King, has decided to hold an election to name his successor.

2.t: Big Sister's Good Image / Sato's Unrequited Love
2.o: Kanade and Akane leave for school to go to a student council meeting. On the way, Kanade points out the obvious flaw in Akane's plan to become king, namely, that it would bring her more attention. Kanade then tries to ditch Akane for clinging to her too closely. Akane is then almost hit by a truck while saving a cat, but Kanade saves her by materializing a giant, shock-absorbent wall. Akane asks how much it cost, and is shocked when Kanade tells her it cost 40,000,000 yen. The second part of the episode focuses on Hana Satō, who is bemoaning that no one at school knows her after she transferre

3.t: I Want to Become Popular / First Errand / Idol Activities
3.o: Akane is chosen to grocery shopping, and Hikari volunteers to go with her. While Akane tries to evade surveillance cameras, Hikari uses her power to age into a woman in order to save a stray cat stuck on a tree. However, this results in her clothes not fitting, and she turns Akane into a child so they can switch clothes. The cat rescued by Hikari is then adopted and named Borscht by the Sakurada family. The next week in the second part, Teru volunteers himself to take over Akane's grocery shopping duties, and Shiori decides to accompany him out of worry that he will get himself into trouble. D

4.t: The Royal Princess' Skirt / The Mysterious Student Council President
4.o: Akane goes to school without a crucial piece of clothing. Also, the student council is making all students participate in a town beautification day. Who is behind this and how will Akane deal with all the cameras?

5.t: Summer Vacation / Online Secret / Eight of Misaki
5.o: It's summer and the Sakurada Royal Family are at the beach! Haruka is doing something fishy on the internet, and Misaki is busy at school as all her clones help out in different clubs. Misaki isn't too happy about it, though.

6.t: The Election and Me / My Big Sister is Sentimental
6.o: During the first part, the Sakurada siblings are busy with their election campaigns and the plot moves to Kanade, whom reveals her intention to become the king: long ago, she brought Akane and Shu to play at a park in their childhood. When she materialized a castle for Akane to play in, it crumbled and injured both Shu and Akane. Shu was the one that mostly affected and it severed his leg (even Kanade's ability proven futile), simultaneously crushing his dream to become a soccer player. Due to this, she wants to become a king in order to advance the medical systems and corrects her past mistak

7.o: The King goes on a business trip, reluctantly leaving Kanade in charge of a Akane and Shiori. Meanwhile, Hikari gets to work with Sacchy, but Sacchy is not friendly. How can Hikari get Sacchy to like her?

8.t: Troubled Sato / The King's Side Trip
8.o: The whole family's superpowers are acting up! Meanwhile, Hana asks Akane for dating advice about Shu. Then, we take a look into the past and see how Akane's mom and dad met.

9.o: We meet Scarlet Bloom, a masked heroine with red pigtails and who can control gravity. Who could her true identity be?! While things are ramping up for the election, it's almost Christmas Eve, which is also Aoi's birthday.

10.t: Search☆Light's Whereabouts / Big Brother Acting Like A Big Bro
10.o: The elections are drawing near and Search☆Light is performingagain, but there is tension in the air between Sachiko and Raito. Meanwhile, even though Kanade and Shu are twins, they have their differences in opinion.

11.o: It's one month before the elections. We learn why Akane hates being in the public eye. Then, due to an unfortunate circumstance, the king cannot perform his duties. How will the Sakurada Royal Siblings save the day?

12.t: Who Will the Crown Shine Upon
12.o: The elections are finally here and the siblings are preparing for their final speeches. Who will be crowned as the successor to the throne?

1.o: Kuro and Benkei, fleeing pursuers, seek refuge in the forest home of Kuromitsu. When Kuro falls ill, Benkei leaves to seek medicine. The pursuers attack Kuro and Kuromitsu, mortally wounding Kuro. Kuromitsu offers Kuro eternal life.

2.o: A corrupt wandering samurai attacks Kuro and Kuromitsu in the town near her home and beheads Kuro. Kuromitsu kills the samurai and attaches Kuro's head to the samurai's body. In flashback, Kuro drinks Kuromitsu's blood, but before his transformation can complete, they are attacked by an enemy who has been hunting Kuromitsu for the secret to her immortality. Kuro is beheaded by Benkei, whom the enemy had recruited to be their new leader.

3.o: Without any memory of how he got there, Kuro awakens in the forest in a post-apocalyptic world. Upon entering a crumbled city of Asuka in search of Kuromitsu, he meets Haniwa resistance member Karuta. The Red Imperial Army attacks the club fronting for the Haniwa HQ. Kuro attacks the Red Imperial Army when he recognizes their emblem as the same as those who hunted Kuromitsu.

4.o: Kuro recovers from the fight with the Red Imperial Army at Rai's apartment. Rai takes Kuro to Izana, who claims he can reunite Kuro with Kuromitsu if Kuro joins the Haniwa rebels against the Red Imperial Army.

5.o: The Haniwa take Kuro to meet the rebel leader, Saniwa. She promises to reunite him with Kuromitsu. The Red Imperial Army seeks Kuromitsu's blood to breed an army of enhanced soldiers.

6.o: Arashiyama and the Red Imperial Army attack Haniwa HQ and Saniwa's residence in search of Kuromitsu's blood.

7.o: Kuro and the Haniwa travel to the underground village of Kagura, but discover the residents slaughtered and Kuromitsu gone.

8.o: The Red Imperial sorceress Kagetsu tortures Saniwa to learn the whereabouts of Kuromitsu. Kuromitsu appears, kills Kagetsu, tells Kuro to go to the Red Imperial HQ, and disappears again. Saniwa dies.

9.o: Kuro and the Haniwa travel to the Red Imperial HQ in Tokyo. Karuta dies.

10.o: Kuro and Rai are captured by the Red Imperial Army. Kuon is revealed to be, among other things, a Red Imperial agent who infiltrated the Haniwa at Kuromitsu's command.

11.o: Hasegawa plans to remove Kuro's head for his experiments. Kuro kills Hasegawa. Kuon kills Rai, then tells Kuro that Kuromitsu planned to use his body as Kuro's perfect new body. Kuro kills Kuon.

12.o: Kuro confronts the Red Emperor, who is revealed to be Benkei, and kills him. Kuromitsu beheads Kuro and places his head on a new body. Kuro awakens in the forest, having lost his memory, and begins again his search for Kuromitsu.

1.o: يصادف "جين ووك"، الشابّ الثري اللعوب الذي يستعدّ ليرث شركة والده، "يو مي" ذات الطموحات المتواضعة، إذ تريد أن تصبح أخصائية تغذية.

2.o: تقضي "يو مي" ليلة بصحبة "جين ووك"، وتطوي الأيام صفحاتها دون اللقاء مجدّدًا. وبعد مرور ثلاث سنوات، تُحقّق حلمها في أن تصبح أخصائية تغذية.

3.o: تجد "يو مي" صعوبة في إرضاء مديرها ومتطلّباته غير المعقولة. وحين تذهب للاعتذار إليه عن رسالتها الإلكترونية حادّة اللهجة، تجد شخصًا غير متوقع.

4.t: The Secret in the Jewelry Box
4.o: حين تُحضِر "يو مي" وجبة لـ"جين ووك" في مكتبه، تصادف "هاي ري"، التي تشتعل غيرتها عندما تكتشف أن "يو مي" تطهو له الوجبات.

5.o: تأخذ "يو مي" أخاها غير الشقيق "دونغ" إلى منزل "جين ووك" لتحضير وجبة له في يوم عطلتها. وعقب وصولهما، يكسر "دونغ" بالخطأ صندوق مجوهرات ثمين.

6.o: يغار "جين ووك" من صداقة "يو مي" و"هيون تاي" المتنامية، فيطلب من "يو مي" أن تعمل لوقت إضافي بغرض منعهما من قضاء المزيد من الوقت معًا.

7.t: This Is How Business Is Done
7.o: توافق "يو مي" على تناول العشاء مع "جين ووك" عشر مرّات مقابل صندوق المجوهرات والرسوم الطبّية، فيحدّدان المواعيد بعد أوقات العمل وفي العطلات.

8.o: بعد العمل تذهب "يو مي" إلى منزل "جين ووك" من أجل تناول وجبة منزلية. وبمجرّد جلوسهما لتناول الطعام، يطرق "داي بوك"، والد "جين ووك"، الباب.

9.o: خلال رحلة عمل، تمكث "يو مي" و"جين ووك" في أحد منتجعات الشركة. وفي تلك الأثناء في "سول"، تزور "هاي ري" التي تنتابها الغيرة "هيون تاي".

10.o: حين يرى "داي بوك" "جين ووك" يلعب مع "دونغ"، يظنّ أن "يو مي" و"جين ووك" لديهما طفل، ويتساءل "جين ووك" أيضًا إذا كان "دونغ" ابنه.

11.t: I'm the Only One Who Can't Date
11.o: تُضايق "هاي ري" "يو مي" لاستحواذها على "جين ووك"، ويزور "داي بوك" منزل "يو مي" ليعرف ما إذا كان "دونغ" حفيده أم لا.

12.t: It's Time to Wake Up From This Dream
12.o: بعد أن تقرّر "يو مي" الاستقالة من وظيفتها، ترحل عن "سول" وتنتقل إلى "دايجون" للعمل في قاعة طعام إحدى الجامعات، وتزورها "هيون تاي" ذات يوم.

13.o: تُلقي "يو مي" باللوم على والدتها بسبب سوء حظها وتذهب إلى الشاطئ الذي التقت فيه "جين ووك" لأول مرة، ثم يعلم هو بمكانها ويلتئم شملهما من جديد.

1.o: When his teenage daughter doesn't return home after a party, Tom Delaney anxiously combs the neighborhood and learns her boyfriend is also missing.

2.o: Fearing a friend was involved in Jenny's disappearance, Tom enlists Sophie's help. Emma investigates disturbing allegations about a teacher.

3.o: An anonymous tip leads to a frenzied chase -- and another puzzling clue. Zoe draws up a list of grudges. Tom glimpses a side of Rachel he never knew.

4.o: While Tom follows a new lead about Jenny, Sophie and Emma deliver devastating news. The Marshalls struggle to keep their cool.

5.o: In the wake of a dangerous confrontation, Sophie warns Tom to stay out of the investigation. Tom learns that Jenny was hiding a secret.

6.o: As a deadly fire rages, Tom frantically tracks Jenny's phone. More details about Chris's death emerge, and a confession tears a family apart.

7.o: Sophie blocks Tom's attempts to speak with Henry. While searching for Bobby at Heaven, Tom and Pete spot a familiar face.

8.o: Tom begs for Sophie's help getting to Bobby. Before the night of the party, a cryptic entry in Rachel's diary sends Jenny on a quest for the truth.

1.t: The Story of One Summer Night and a Confession
1.o: After helping out at Kino's beach house during a lunch rush, Futaba decides to return there the next day while Hikari goes scuba diving with the others. While there, Hikari accidentally goes into an outdoor hot spring without her bikini top, putting her at risk of being exposed before the other girls come to save her. Later, after Hikari holds a barbecue party for everyone, Futaba worries about what she'd do if she has to part ways with Hikari, but Hikari encourages her to enjoy every moment they spend together.

2.t: The Story of Midsummer and the Sparkling Eyes
2.o: While Futaba is away for a memorial at her country home, Hikari befriends a girl by the sea who is fascinated by a mother octopus guarding her young - Futaba is determined to befriend her. Meanwhile, Futaba works hard as a volunteer helping to set up the local fireworks festival, working hard enough to earn front row seats in the VIP section of the festival for her friends.

3.t: The Story of the Pro and the Expert of Happiness
3.o: Futaba takes the underwater navigation tutorial but is brought crashing back to reality by the realization that she may be holding Hikari back - but is able to successfully complete it after she remembers all the lessons she had been taught by her friends. After watching the twins go on a night time dive, Futaba wrestles with the feeling that she may be holding Hikari back.

4.t: The Story of Autumn and a Tender Happiness
4.o: Futaba and Hikari spend an autumn day apart, and they both find autumn wonders of their own.

5.t: The Story of the Jet-Black Mermaid and the Solitude of 18m Under
5.o: Futaba goes diving in a drysuit, as the gang looks to encounter the legendary Jet-Black Mermaid.

6.t: The Story of a Halloween Night's Dream
6.o: It's Halloween, and the Diving Club members find themselves in the midst of a special event in an amusement park. Hikari's in danger, and it's up to Futaba to be her knight in shining armor?

7.t: The Story of the Neverending School Festival
7.o: The Yumegaoka High Dream Festival arrives, and the night before, the entire student body is busy preparing for opening day. This night would end up becoming a very special one for Ai in particular, as she has a very special encounter.

8.t: The Story of Fleeting, Unfulfilled Desires
8.o: After meeting Peter in an encounter straight out of fantasy, Ai now gets transported to a fantasy world, where she meets someone she never expected to meet.

9.t: The Story of Tears and an Endless Dream
9.o: Ai can't accept how Peter parted with Mato-chan and her, and so she decides to head back to Neverland, only this time she has company.

10.t: The Story of a New Beginning and New Feelings
10.o: Teko is invited to bring in the new year at Amanchu-ya, and she finds herself in the company of the whole gang plus a few extras. As they watch the first sunrise, a new kind of emotion takes over her and Pikari.

11.t: The Story of Cold, Flames, and Well Wishes
11.o: Pikari ends up with a cold on her birthday, so Teko decides to visit her at home. She finds someone on the way, which leads to plans for another fun event once Pikari recovers.

12.o: It's finally time for Teko's advanced certification test, with a promise of a night-diving celebration if she passes!

1.o: Zelda Sayre yearns to break free from the monotony of Montgomery. She sees her chance when she meets a young soldier named Scott Fitzgerald.

2.o: As Scott pursues Zelda in Montgomery, she must decide what she can sacrifice to be with him.

3.o: Despite living worlds apart, Scott and Zelda grow closer. Zelda tries to decide if she loves him enough to uproot her whole life.

4.o: Zelda arrives in NYC to marry Scott. They celebrate their new life with all his Big City friends.

5.o: Zelda changes her look and finds her new identity as she tries to fit in with her new high-life in New York City.

6.o: Zelda flirts with Hollywood when she does a screen test for a big director.

7.t: Where There Are Friends, There Are Riches
7.o: Scott and Zelda go to Princeton for a reunion filled with emotion.

8.o: Scott and Zelda get away to a Westport vacation house so Scott can write. They have New York friends over for a party.

9.o: Scott and Zelda work through rising marital tensions at their Westport house.

10.o: Scott and Zelda take a road trip back to Montgomery in an attempt to mend their marriage.

1.o: When young couple Guy and Rosemary Woodhouse arrive in Paris seeking a fresh start, they find comfort in the new city and land a prestigious apartment. Yet Rosemary soon discovers the abode has a haunted past.

2.o: Guy's career soars as a pregnant Rosemary's health deteriorates. Before long, true motives are revealed and Rosemary faces unspeakable horror when her due date approaches.

1.o: Patriot Blue clash with anarchist group Antifasc at a Muslim festival. Kane’s arrival disrupts the balance, and causes ripples through his estranged family. Laila is thrust into the role of publically representing a community.

2.t: If Blood Should Stain The Wattle
2.o: Kane broadens Patriot Blue’s mission and his relationship with its leader’s wife, Zoe, reconnects with his sister Cindi. Gabe is heartbroken by Kane moving in fascist circles, but has keeps own shadowy connections.

3.o: Blake is suspicious of Kane’s rising popularity and puts him to the test. Kane makes his move to assume power. Gabe alerts Marco of Kane’s return, and police intelligence is compromised.

4.o: Kane’s takeover of Patriot Blue gathers momentum. After a failed ambush at a Patriot Blue funeral, Antifasc strikes back, with consequences spiralling out of control, inflaming racial tensions.

5.o: Both sides become focused on George Anabasis, a centrist politician with influence over a controversial Muslim immigration bill. Laila seeks his protection. Kane’s attention is diverted by his feelings for Zoe and a potential deal with Marco.

6.o: The story concludes in real time, as the competing groups converge on Anabasis. Extreme sentiments are enflamed on all sides and a violent conclusion ensues.

1.t: LET'S USE OUR RESOURCES WITH CARE / HORROR! BLOODY MANSION SLAUGHTER DANCE
1.o: While Risu tracks down the Cross-Eyes' hideout, Kasukabe's group heads off to find the professor's estranged wife, only to make a gruesome discovery.

2.t: MEOTO ZENZAI / MASTEMA SUBNADE / THE TRAGIC TALE OF THE CROSS-EYES
2.o: The battle heats up as Shin and Noi fight for their lives. Caiman and Nikaido find themselves being followed as they explore a bustling underground city.

3.t: SWEET HOME / SHINING YOUTH / MEMORIES KEEP CIRCLING ROUND AND ROUND / COME BACK HOME
3.o: Ebisu regains her memories after eating En's new product. Meanwhile, Caiman experiences a violent flashback and Kasukabe goes grave-digging in the Hole.

4.t: GOLDEN BEETLES ARE RICH / CUTE BUTCHER / DOOR TO THE PAST
4.o: So the Cross-Eyes gang figured they’d make the landlord’s murder look like a suicide, huh? As for Asu, who dared to keep things from me, I made sure he paid for it.

5.t: MEETING IN THE RAIN / TRAVEL COMPANIONS / FINAL NIGHT FOR TWO
5.o: Looks like Ebisu got her memory back, thanks to eating some weird mushrooms, and now she’s all eager to head back to her parents’ place.

6.o: En’s found the lizard guy and Nikaido, and they’re going at it hard. Meanwhile, the Cross-Eyes guys are sitting around swapping stories about their boss.

7.t: MY SECRET PLAN / CROSS-EYE EXPEDITION / DEFORMED REUNION
7.o: Fujita's losing his mind trying to get Kikurage to bring Ebisu back to life. The Cross-Eyes guys are scrambling for cash, and things around En are starting to get kind of dicey.

8.o: I never imagined En would go down that easily. The sorcerers are thrown into total chaos. And now I get why Nikaido doesn't use magic.

9.t: MOSH PIT / CROSS-EYES IN THE NEWS
9.o: The Cross-Eyes boss has finally shown up. The En Family's been wiped out, and it looks like the Cross-Eyes have taken over that huge mansion.

10.o: Looks like they've found missing Kikurage. And that bastard Asu, well, Kawajiri now, is sneaking around, up to something weird again. That Haru chick’s getting a little too carried away.

11.t: BALLAD OF THE HAPPY DESTRUCTION / QUESTION & ANSWER
11.o: Looks like Kawajiri and Nikaido have slipped into En's mansion, which the Cross-Eyes have taken over. There, Nikaido runs right into Aikawa. The mystery surrounding the Cross-Eyes boss just keeps getting deeper.

1.o: Lee So Hyun, a high school dropout and a runaway girl, always thought that her dad has passed away. However, it turns out that he just abandoned her. Enough is enough. Having nothing more to lose from her already miserable whole 19 years of life, she decides to hear her dad's side of the story. Knowing that her dad doesn't even realize her face, she rents a house near her dad's and slowly steps into his life.

2.o: So Hyun plans out how to ruin Jae Young's happiness, and decides to get rid of his loved ones out of his life. So Hyun starts to hang out with Yoon Ho more often so she can naturally bump into Bok Hee, her dad's girlfriend. So Hyun thinks that Bok Hee will be disappointed to find out that she is actually Jae Young's daughter and will break up with him in the end. Meanwhile, So Hyun takes revenge on Jun Sik first.

3.o: So Hyun tells Bok Hee the truth and apologizes for lying to everyone. Even though Bok Hee promised not to tell Jae Young about it, So Hyun changes her plan and wants to get rid of Bok Hee as soon as possible. Meanwhile, Jae Young suggests going on a trip together, and So Hyun decides to carry out her new plan during the trip.

4.o: After So Hyun finds out the truth about Jae Young, she regrets what she has done to everyone, but it was too late to take it back. She goes back to Yu Mi to spit her anger out at her. However, she starts to think that she was the only problem, not the people around her. Therefore, she decides to disappear and leave them alone.

1.o: Billionaire Glenn Stearns is determined to conceive and grow another million-dollar business from scratch in just 90 days in Erie, Pennsylvania.

2.o: Billionaire Glenn Stearns hits a breaking point that sends him to the hospital and threatens to shut down his mission to identify a new business and grow it to a $1-million valuation in just 90 days.

3.t: Take The Bull By The Horns
3.o: To fund his new company, Glenn gambles all the money he's earned so far on his biggest money-making scheme yet, but a major roadblock threatens to shut it all down.

4.o: Glenn doubles down on his million-dollar idea with a bold new plan to expand the business. But in the midst of making deals, Glenn's confronted with the prospect of losing all of his startup funds, leaving him fighting to keep the dream alive.

5.o: With his team depending on him, Glenn loses a critical deal and is sent spinning. As the pressure mounts, the underdogs rally to flip a house that could save the business and change their lives forever.

6.o: The Underdog BBQ team races to prepare for their opening day, but when Glenn accidentally reveals his true identity to a team member, it puts the entire business and the bet in jeopardy.

7.o: Glenn sinks everything into Underdog BBQ's big debut and first chance to make money. But before the cash register even opens, the team's plan goes up in flames, threatening the future of the company before the 90-day deadline.

8.o: Glenn's 90 days are up and it's time to find out if his business is worth a million dollars. But first, Glenn reveals his true identity to his team as well as what each one of them has earned for their part of Underdog BBQ.

2.o: Grant hustles for a big score to kickstart his business and get out of the RV, Monique needs work and pressure tests her concept, and with her back against the wall, Elaine lands on a million-dollar idea.

3.o: After a catastrophic setback, Grant struggles to regain his footing. Monique goes all in on her $1 million idea. Elaine races full steam ahead to expand her team and land a critical business partner.

4.o: It could be game over for one of the entrepreneurs.

5.o: The entrepreneurs double down in the face of adversity.

6.t: Be Afraid, But Do It Anyway
6.o: Elaine loses an investor, Monique gains a side hustle and Grant struggles.

7.o: Grant faceplants during an investor pitch. Monique rebrands a business.

8.o: A deal implodes for Grant. Elaine faces a crumbling ceiling at the inn.

9.o: Grant threatens to quit. Monique opens up Rooted. Elaine hosts a big event.

10.o: Grant faces his team about their suspicions.

11.o: One entrepreneur issues a manifesto to motivate the team.

12.o: With only seven days left, pressures intensify for all three entrepreneurs.

13.o: At day 90, the entrepreneurs make a final push before valuations.

1.o: Choi Han-su, who's fallen on hard times, decides to leave the city and return to his hometown. Soon, he bumps into his old classmate Jung Eun-hui.

2.o: The class reunion ends with a tiff. Eun-hui considers a startling suggestion from Han-su, unaware that not everything with him is all it seems.

3.o: When Eun-hui leaves on an overnight getaway with Han-su, her concerned friends discover the secrets he's been keeping from them all.

4.o: When Park Jeong-jun chases off her annoying admirer, Lee Yeong-ok asks him to go for a walk. At work, the other divers disapprove of her methods.

5.o: Bang Yeong-ju plans to graduate high school and leave the island behind, but an unwanted roadblock threatens everything. Jung Hyeon worries about her.

6.o: At a low place in her life, Min Seon-a finds herself heading to Jeju. Seeing her again brings back aggravating memories for Lee Dong-seok.

7.o: Committed to their decision, Yeong-ju and Hyeon agree to stop hiding their situation. Coming clean to their fathers is the toughest ordeal.

8.o: Bang Ho-sik and Jung In-gwon each vehemently disagree with their children's wishes. An unbudging Yeong-ju leaves home for a motel.

9.o: When Seon-a is nowhere to be seen, Dong-seok leaves to find her. When he does, she offers answers to the questions he always had, but never asked.

10.o: Ahead of an all-important decision that is out of her hands, Seon-a heads back up to Seoul for her son's birthday. Dong-seok accompanies her.

11.t: Dong-seok and Seon-a, Yeong-ok and Jeong-jun
11.o: Seon-a shares her next steps with a supportive Dong-seok. Yeong-ok ignores being cast out by the other divers, and enjoys a date with Jeong-jun.

12.o: Yeong-ok has a close call in the water. Everyone in the village eagerly welcomes back Ko Mi-ran, but Eun-hui seems noticeably on edge.

13.o: Left alone in Eun-hui's house, Mi-ran cannot resist the urge to read her friend's diaries. Hurtful revelations follow.

14.o: Yeong-ok abruptly pushes Jeong-jun away when her closely guarded secret threatens to make an appearance on the island.

15.o: Jeong-jun sticks by Yeong-ok's side and gets to know her visitor, who has yet to show anyone the drawings in her sketchbooks.

16.o: Hyeon Chun-hui finds her hands full when her granddaughter is dropped off at her house for two weeks, and wonders if something might be amiss.

17.o: An overheard conversation leads to heartbreak for Chun-hui. Son Eun-gi tells the villagers about all the wishes she wants to make.

18.o: Upon hearing major news about his mother, Dong-seok does not know exactly how to feel. He deliberates over a request she's asked of him.

19.o: Yeong-ok hesitates before meeting Jeong-jun's parents. Dong-seok tells Kang Ok-dong that he will do anything she wants during their trip to Mokpo.

20.o: Dong-seok and Ok-dong make a series of impromptu detours on their way back home. Their time together allows old wounds to heal.

3.o: Mariano's investigation brings danger into his and his wife's home; Koenig searches for a traitor.
